citation.title: Standard Chartered Journey Credit Card (Annual Fee Payable)

extra.summary: Introducing the Standard Chartered Journey Credit Card – your ultimate companion for rewarding journeys and everyday expenses. Earn 3 miles per S$1 spent on transportation, food deliveries, and online groceries, making your daily commute and dining experiences even more rewarding. Earn 2 miles per S$1 for overseas spend, perfect for your international adventures. Plus, earn 1.2 miles per S$1 for local spends, ensuring you accumulate miles no matter where you are

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Minimum Monthly Repayment: S$50 or 1% of Principal/ Interest, Fees & Charges/ Overlimit amount/ Past Due amount, whichever is higher

documents-required.SG Citizens or PRs:
Apply via MyInfo and prepare the following, 
1. Copy of Passport (6 months validity), and page with address displayed (where applicable), 
2. Copy of Employment Pass, 
3. Either one of the following: utility bill, tax bill, latest bank /credit card statement, rental agreement showing your address, latest mobile phone statement, letter from employer stating current address, government-issued document stating current address

our_takes.our-take: The Standard Chartered Journey Card targets frequent travellers, especially those loyal to Singapore Airlines, with up to 3 miles per S$1 spent and KrisFlyer transfers. The 25,000 points anniversary bonus helps offset the S$196.20 annual fee, but note the 4,500 monthly bonus points cap. Two annual Priority Pass lounge visits offer comfort during delays; SMS activation is required. Consider this card if you can maximize miles earning via transportation, food deliveries, and online groceries—otherwise, a lower-fee card might be a better fit.
our_takes.good-for:
Frequent flyers seeking accelerated miles on foreign spending and complimentary lounge access for comfortable travel.
Urban professionals who frequently use Grab to or from Changi Airport, enjoying discounts on transportation.
Individuals who value non-expiring rewards points, providing flexibility in redeeming miles for future travel plans.
our_takes.things-to-note:
Annual fee of S$196.20 could offset rewards earned if spending is low; evaluate if benefits outweigh the cost.
A high 27.90% interest rate can negate rewards value; aim to pay your balance in full each month.
Bonus points are capped at 4,500 monthly, factor this as it limits higher spending rewards.
